description: Horaires théoriques du réseau Tarbes / Lourdes - TLP mobilités (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by TLP Mobilités. Theoretical timetables of the Tarbes / Lourdes network - TLP mobilities (GTFS) This resource is part of the Urban Network TLP Mobility dataset. The file covers the period from 40/08/2026 to 16/10/2026 Network: TLP Mobility Modes of transport: bus only. Coverage: TLP Mobilités. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical timetables of the Tarbes / Lourdes network - TLP mobilities (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is TLP Mobilités. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
